objects.name: Distribution cabinet
objects.description: Small electrical box low in the cave pit (cells 97-98, row 46). Shooting it with the gun from the cave floor (engine y 42, x >= 87) plays delo.anm, puts 2 blasts on it and switches the cannon off ([0x5481]=1, map M32). No hit points: one shot does it (5:0x704B). Its tiles change from (8,32/33) to (8,53/54) in M32/M33.

refs.caption: demo: round vent with a yellow E sign, cabinet candidate

objects.name: Cannon turret
objects.description: Dome gun turret on a short pedestal at the east end of plank row 32 (cell 90,31), map tiles. While the cabinet is intact, a hero at cells 90-98 on that floor gets strilna.anm, 3 blasts, (6 - shields)/6 x 30 energy and a push one cell right and one row down (3:0xE42D). Cannot be destroyed; the cabinet shot switches it off. LEV3.GRA f25 holds a dome turret sprite (8 frames, firing right) that level 3 does not use as a guard.

objects.name: Small key
objects.description: Item record 5 (KLIC) lying in the grass at cell 54 on plank row 32, in front of a small building. Pickup plays klic.anm: V TRAVE JSI NASEL MALY KLIC. Opens the flamethrower door (9).

objects.name: Tripwire trap
objects.description: Tensioned wire between two posts (cells 52-53, rows 35-36) on plank row 37, item records 3 and 4 (NAPNUTY DRAT) at cells 54-55 that cannot be picked up. Walking into cell 55 while it is armed sets off 45 blast rounds and ends the game (3:0xE742). Using the cutters there removes it and gives the grenade (sebgra.anm, granat.anm).

objects.name: Bulky boulder
objects.description: Large rock over the spike strip of plank row 20, used from cells 46-54. Wrong item: MOHUTNY KAMEN. The grenade (hodgra.anm, skala1.anm, skala2.anm) collapses it onto the spikes (map M33): PO EXPLOZI SE ZAVALILA CAST PREKAZKY. Not drawn in M31 tiles (probably a sprite) [inferred].

refs.caption: map M31: rock area and spikes

objects.name: Spike pit
objects.description: Strip of spikes on plank row 20, cells 53-60, with no floor tiles: a hero who walks or falls in drops to engine y 15 and dies (OSTNY.anm, 3:0xE9F7). After the grenade, rubble gives floor cells 57-58, so a running jump gets over.

objects.name: Stone puzzle
objects.description: Four-stone panel used from cells 104-105 on the ledge at plank row 17. Opens a close-up screen (6:0xB514): move over raised stones, Enter presses one; each press also toggles or releases others by a 4-step counter. All four pressed: Z VODOPADU NAD TEBOU SE VYSUNULY DVA KAMENNE BLOKY and map M34. Otherwise NIC SE NESTALO.

objects.name: Waterfall
objects.description: Tall grey waterfall column at cells 94-99, rows 3-20, between plank rows 20 and 11. Solving the puzzle slides out two stone blocks (cells 96,12 and 98,13) that act as steps up to floor 11 (M34). Ambient sound while the hero is nearby (3:0xBF20) [inferred].

refs.caption: demo: two blocks in the waterfall

objects.name: Door to the flamethrower
objects.description: Door in a small building with a red lamp on plank row 41 (use from cells 119-123). Locked without the key: DVERE JSOU ZAMCENE. With the key: dvere.anm, ZA DVERMI JSI OBJEVIL PLAMENOMET, weapon slot 3 becomes the flamethrower with 500 ammo (3:0x95EC).

objects.name: Flamethrower
objects.description: Bonus weapon 3 of levels 3 and 4: a particle stream (40 particles, table ds:0x499E), 0.03 hp per particle tick on enemies within 1 cell. Starts with 500 ammo and carries into level 4.

objects.name: Crate with cutters
objects.description: Wooden crate under the helicopter wreck at cell 83 on plank row 32, item record 2 (BEDNA). Pickup plays bedna.anm, renames it to STIPACKY: UVNITR BEDNY JSI NASEL STIPACKY. Same thing as the mesto crate, here holding a quest item.

objects.name: Wire cutters
objects.description: Item given by the crate (record 2 renamed). Used on the tripwire, then gone.

objects.name: Grenade
objects.description: Item given by cutting the tripwire (record 3 renamed GRANAT). Thrown at the boulder, then gone.

objects.name: Fuel canister
objects.description: Item record 1 (KANYSTR) at cell 100 on the small ledge at plank row 40, beside the orange car wreck. Pickup plays kanistr.anm: NALEZL JSI KANYSTR S PALIVEM. Poured into the jeep.

objects.name: Jeep with winch
objects.description: Jeep on plank row 11 at cells 80-83, rows 9-10, east of the fallen tree. Canister used at cells 78-84: napln.anm, DO NADRZE AUTOMOBILU JSI NALIL PALIVO. Then any use at cells 76-80 runs the winch (navijak.anm, sutr.anm), pulls the tree away and ends the level (3:0x97CC).

objects.name: Fallen tree
objects.description: Tree trunk lying across plank row 11 at cells 70-81, rows 7-10; west wall of floor 11 (wall table x 71). Pulled away by the jeep winch at the level end.

objects.name: Rusty tower lift
objects.description: Scripted lift between two lattice towers: up at cells 140-143 on plank row 41 plays vytnah.anm and puts the hero at cell 118 on the spawn ledge (row 25); down at cells 116-119 plays vytdol.anm back to cell 141 (7:0x815E). No lift slot and no visible deck: the ride is a cutscene. Same role as the mesto lift, different mechanics.

refs.caption: map: blue pole at the bottom stop
map: upper tower near the top stop

objects.name: Rusty lattice tower
objects.description: Rusted riveted steel truss towers with X bracing (spawn ledge, tower lift); our own variant instead of the grey mesto pylon. Sized by w and h in cells.

objects.name: Land mine
objects.description: One-shot mines at cells 126,25 (spawn ledge), 108,41 and 97,35 (rock slope). Stepping on one takes (6 - shields)/6 x 15 energy with 3 blasts (7:0x9EAE). Drawn from far pointer ds:0xDF00; picture [open].

objects.name: Bonus pickups
objects.description: Hidden floor bonuses, one shot each: energy +90 at cell 25,31, second ammo type +350 at cell 65,37, shield +1 at cell 29,25 (seg 5).

refs.caption: map: west rock ledges with the energy and shield bonus cells

objects.name: Cave pit and chasm
objects.description: Pit at cells 83-100, rows 42-50, below the stepped rock. A hero falling below its floor (engine y > 42, x > 77) dies: propast.anm, game over (3:0xE6CD).

objects.name: Cave capsule
objects.description: Rounded metal capsule in the cave pit at cells 86-87, rows 46-47. Decor; no code found.

objects.name: Rock ledges
objects.description: Stacked rock ledges at cells 22-47, rows 20-37, one row apart: the hero climbs them with the jump (32 px rise) and drops between them (gravity).

objects.name: Rock slope
objects.description: Stepped rock joining plank row 32 to row 41 at cells 92-100, rows 33-40.

objects.name: Girder column
objects.description: Vertical girder at the west map edge (cell 22, rows 15-37); the west wall table entries (x 17) stop the hero here. Also the 1 cell riveted post under every girder platform (h in cells).

objects.name: Helicopter wreck
objects.description: Crashed bronze helicopter at cells 79-84, rows 27-31 on plank row 32; the crate sits under it.

objects.name: Red excavator
objects.description: Abandoned mining excavator over the spawn at cells 131-137, rows 22-24.

objects.name: Overgrown building
objects.description: Small concrete buildings with barred windows on plank rows 20 and 32 (cells 37-44 and 50-57). State 1 adds a steel door and a roof vent with an antenna mast, state 2 a scorched shell hole with rubble below; sized by w and h.

objects.name: Fence
objects.description: Fence beside the door building on plank row 41; same as mesto.

objects.name: Parallax sky
objects.description: Jungle backdrop from LEV3.GRA frame 0, scrolls slower than the playfield. Our variant: misty teal forest of trunk silhouettes, canopy blobs and mist bands, dark under the floors.

objects.name: Car wreck
objects.description: Orange wrecked car at cells 103-109, rows 38-40, by the canister.

refs.caption: demo: droids by the car wreck

objects.name: Chemical tank
objects.description: Chrome horizontal tank with dome ends, orange valve saddles and a trefoil, single on the camp floor by the waterfall (cells 85-89, row 19) and a stacked pair at 58-72 r27-31.

objects.name: Far trees
objects.description: Flat dark trunk silhouettes `#0c3024` with canopy blobs `#184830`, under the haze; tall enough to pass behind the floor above.

objects.name: Far tower ruin
objects.description: Flat dark silhouettes `#0c3018` of an overgrown lattice tower and a broken bunker with vines.

objects.name: Cobble fill
objects.description: Rounded stones in staggered courses, two per cell: `#3c3c30`, `#3c483c`, `#303c3c`, light `#545448`, dark green grout `#182418`; mossy state adds moss tufts. World-anchored pattern like vesnice `stoneWall`.

objects.name: Jungle walkway
objects.description: Top half: alternating olive X-plate (`#484830`, `#303024`) and grey stone blocks (`#606054`, `#786c60`), a beaded orange-yellow trim strip under it; boulder state hangs a row of pale boulders (`#84786c`, light `#909078`, shade `#303024`); cave state a dark green band `#182418` with thin teal lines `#18483c`.

objects.name: Plank bridge
objects.description: Riveted olive-brown top band `#483c24` with bolts and box insets, two brown planks `#604824`, `#6c3c18` under it, dark lower edge; ends rest on `girderColumn` posts.

objects.name: Brass deck
objects.description: Two rows: brass L-brackets `#6c6030` with bright edges `#e4c048`, teal-grey panels `#243030`, `#3c483c`, small white lamp slots, dark legs.

objects.name: Brick ruin
objects.description: Dark brown bricks `#483024`, `#60543c`, `#6c603c` with a stepped broken top falling to one side, scorch and dirt.

objects.name: Stone stack
objects.description: Flat grey-tan boulders stacked and balanced, each slightly offset, moss on the top stone (`STONE` palette).

objects.name: Coolant pipe
objects.description: Teal pipe `#18483c` with a light stripe `#3c8478`, steel posts `#546060` every cell, a brown lower plate `#3c3018`; vertical state a thin silver pipe.

objects.name: Rock debris
objects.description: Loose stones and short broken trunk pieces `#604824` on a ledge.

objects.name: Deck railing
objects.description: Brass handrail `#9c6c3c` with highlights `#e4c048`, dark girder posts, two rails.

objects.name: Fern bush
objects.description: The berry bush at 54 r35 (`#304818`, `#3c6018`, `#243c18`, red berries) and the demo ferns, from `fern`, `frond`, `leafBlob`. Never reads like a pickup.

objects.name: Log pile
objects.description: Cut logs, bark `#604824`, pale cut faces `#9c846c` with rings, moss.

objects.name: Oil drum
objects.description: Rust-brown drum `#604824` with moss `#3c6018`, a dark leak pool when tipped. Not light brown, so it never reads as the crate.

objects.name: Rock vent
objects.description: Oval steel rim `#546060` with horizontal slats in a rock face, rust drips; open state a dark hole with a bent slat.

objects.name: Energy sign
objects.description: Yellow octagon `#e4c048` with a black E on a short bracket, rust at the edge.
